metadata.description: Free, open AI-agent skills from Majarrah Nexus.

plugins.name: skill-craft
plugins.description: Technical review, guided walkthroughs, and a human-attention approval gate for agent skills, slash commands, and plugins — a fixed 10-dimension safety/severity audit, a clear five-part walkthrough, and a decision layer that says how much a human must read before approving. Custom-agent review and authoring are not included.

plugins.name: code-craft
plugins.description: Clean Architecture feature implementation for any stack — mobile (Flutter, Android, iOS, React Native), web frontend, backend service, or desktop. Bundled mappings ship for the four mobile stacks and Node backends; every other stack is derived live from the project's own conventions, which are detected first and always win over the skill's defaults.
